patch_description: Add a single shared long-range entangling layer (CRZ with one shared parameter "g") on opposite-qubit pairs [0,4], [1,5], [2,6], [3,7] before the existing RX(a)/RY(a) rotation layer. This seeds long-range correlations at the very start of the circuit at the cost of just one extra trainable parameter, which prior evidence suggests substantially amplifies the effectiveness of subsequent local rotations and ring entanglers for robust generalization on hard groups, without adding to circuit depth in a costly way (only 4 gates).
